title: Brand
description: The venture's brand tokens, in the marketing package at marketing/brand.json: colors, typefaces with their licenses, the font each role uses, voice rules (the global stylesheet for words), the logo and marks, outside design systems by reference, and scopes where a route prefix overrides the venture brand (nearer context wins). Read by every agent's layout and every interface; checked by packages/naive/src/checks/check-brand.mjs. Translates Next.js global CSS, next/font and file-based icons (Y-3, Y-4, Y-5, T-1, T-2, P-24). Version 0.x, unevaluated.

fonts.description: Role (body, heading, mono, display...) -> typeface id

avoid.description: A phrase, or phrases, the venture's words never use; matched as whole words, ignoring case

tone.description: How the venture sounds, in a few words each

name.description: The name as the brand writes it

typefaces.description: Each typeface, defined once with its license (T-1). self-hosted: its files are in public/ and registered, so a browser makes no outside request; system: the reader's own fonts; remote: served from another host (the check fails it)

license.description: An SPDX id such as OFL-1.1, or owned, or licensed

fonts.description: The font each role uses everywhere, as the root layout applies it (T-2)

marks.description: The logo and marks (P-24), each a registered file in public/

design_systems.description: Outside design systems the brand builds on, by reference: linked, with a version and license, never copied in (Y-4)

uses.description: What the venture takes from it

scopes.description: Overrides for a route prefix (a package such as investors, or one item such as investors/deck). Nearer context wins: a deeper prefix over a shallower one, any scope over the venture brand (Y-5, T-2)
